paper.$description: Paper — Page background, navigation bar, footer background

carbon.$description: Carbon — Primary text, dark buttons, outlines, dark iconography, and dark feature surfaces

tile-gray.$description: Tile Gray — Logo tiles, integration cards, pale product modules

mist.$description: Mist — Inverse text on dark surfaces and subdued pale interface areas

steel.$description: Steel — Eyebrows, muted labels, and monochrome partner marks

white.$description: White — Text and icons on Carbon or Electric Blue controls

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Highlighted headline words, inline product links, selected icon strokes, and rare filled controls — the hard violet-blue creates a technical interruption in the otherwise grayscale system

nbinternationalpro.$description: The sole interface and display family: 400 handles compact navigation, links, and reading text; 500 carries headings from 24px through the 70px hero. The 64px and 70px displays use -2.56px and -2.816px tracking respectively; the 24px subheads use -0.48px. This compressed display tracking makes the large statements feel engineered rather than promotional.

geistmono.$description: Sparse code-like and product-detail text inside technical interface content; use it only where a software artifact needs a distinct machine-readable texture.
